newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Goncz vetoes conflict of interest bill.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Goncz vetoes conflict of interest bill.

text.p: Hungarian President Arpad Goncz has vetoed a conflict of interest bill passed last month by Parliament.
The bill bans MPs from holding positions in companies with a state-owned stake of over ten percent.
A source at the President's Office told Reuters one of the main reasons Goncz had rejected the bill was that it applies only to posts taken up since the 1994 elections.
"The bill seriously discriminates between groups of MPs based on whether the business interests were acquired before or after the 1994 elections," the source, who declined to be named, said.
